initialization: fresh matching pretrained CodeBERT; identical seed42 linear head

input_protocol.pooling: mean over unique source positions; repeated prefix/BOS/EOS averaged across windows

encoder_precision: FP32 weights/optimizer; BF16 CUDA autocast; FP32 head/pooling/loss

vat.precision: FP32 auxiliary encoder/head; float64 Bernoulli KL and perturbation norms
vat.norm: per function L2 over expanded actual encoder tokens, including overlapping-window copies
vat.sampling: original source only; one VAT term per original function per epoch
vat.eligibility: all functions with non-special visible source tokens; no syntax or surface-site gate

function_name: input-only current declaration name; external APIs/callees unchanged
loss: one BCE and one ordinary embedding VAT term per original function; no transformed training sources
selection: original clean Valid MCC threshold/epoch and tie-break; no Test
